formulas.verbatim: Convert decimal odds O to raw implied probability q=1/O (or American odds: q=|A|/(|A|+100) for negative A and q=100/(A+100) for positive A).
Remove an overround for a mutually exclusive market with p_i=(1/O_i)/sum_j(1/O_j).
For a one-unit stake and model probability p, EV=p(O-1)-(1-p)=pO-1; the edge is p-p_no_vig (or model fair odds 1/p versus offered O).
For a binary decimal-price bet with net payout D-1, EV per unit stake is p_model(D-1)-(1-p_model); publish edge p_model-p_fair, EV, posterior interval, vig method and stale-line/limit flags.
calculate EV for a $1 stake as EV=p_hat*net_win-(1-p_hat)*stake-fees, edge=p_hat-p_market, and CLV against a timestamped closing line.
Closing Line Value (CLV): persist the exact offered price, timestamp and defined close; compute CLV_pp=p_close,no-vig-p_bet,no-vig (and optionally normalize by p_bet).

For net odds b=O-1, model win probability p and q=1-p, full Kelly is f*=(bp-q)/b. Use fractional Kelly f=omega f* with 0<omega<1 (for example, half-Kelly means omega=0.5), but calculate p from the posterior or a conservative lower credible bound, cap single-market and sport exposure, and optimize jointly for correlated bets rather than adding independent Kelly stakes. Set f=0 for non-positive or insufficiently certain edge.
rank by fractional Kelly f*=edge/odds and cap it (e.g., 0.1 Kelly) with portfolio covariance and max-drawdown constraints.

Let W_t be bankroll after each settlement and W_ref a high-water/reference wealth. Solve a constrained fractional-Kelly allocation that maximizes expected log wealth subject to Pr(min_t W_t < alpha W_ref) <= beta, with portfolio variance f^T Sigma f and correlation-aware exposure caps.

for soccer, low-scoring baseball runs, hockey goals and event counts use log(lambda_home)=alpha+attack_home-defense_away+venue+covariates and an analogous away rate, with negative-binomial alternatives for overdispersion.
Estimate P(A)=M^-1 sum I(A_m), joint probabilities with I(all legs), and uncertainty with Monte Carlo standard errors; use reproducible seeds, convergence checks and scenario sweeps.
Price over/under with P(X>line)=sum of the simulated tail; preserve correlations between player usage, score state, pace and team total.
EPA is EP(S_{t+1})-EP(S_t); roll the transition kernel until the drive or half reaches an absorbing state.

For salary DFS, solve a mixed-integer program: maximize E[fantasy_points] + lambda*leverage - risk_penalty, subject to salary cap, roster/position, team/game limits and late-swap; add covariance-aware variance/CVaR and ownership fade/stack constraints.
Prop impact is the difference between scenario distributions: Delta P = P(prop|injury scenario)-P(prop|baseline), with uncertainty intervals and a minimum edge threshold.

note: F03/F04/F05 are three verbatim variants of one canonical EV formula; F07/F08 are two verbatim variants of fractional Kelly. 15 verbatim strings, 10 canonical formulas. Verbatim text is character-faithful to the source value modulo JSON escaping.
